title: Once the Regent tries to reopen the vault (the 'Pennywell, After' beat), choosing to keep it sealed 'whatever it costs' resolves in a single line with Averil and no return trip, garrison, or lasting threat state - the promised standing cost is real (Crown -1) but the scene itself is one exchange, so the 'cost' feels abstract rather than something you have to weather.
where: The Counting-House, Pennywell / 'keep it sealed, whatever it costs'
